title: Fluffy Korean Steamed Egg
summary: A soft, savoury Korean steamed egg with a light custardy texture and fresh spring onion on top. It’s quick, comforting, and ideal for a warm breakfast.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk until fully blended but not too foamy.
Add the water and salt, then whisk again until combined.
Pour the mixture into a heatproof bowl or small pot and strain it if you want an extra-smooth custard.
Place over very low heat with a lid on, or steam for about 12 to 15 minutes, until the egg is just set and softly jiggly in the middle.
Top with the sliced spring onion, sesame oil, and a pinch of black pepper, then serve immediately while hot.
